sources.entry: Elephant in the Blameless War Room: Accountability

summary.name: FireHydrant
summary.one_liner: FireHydrant is an incident management platform that combines on-call scheduling, alerting, automated runbooks, Slack/Teams incident handling, AI-enhanced retrospectives, and status pages.
use_cases: managing production incidents in Slack or Teams
scheduling on-call rotations and alerting engineers
writing AI-assisted retrospectives and tracking follow-up actions
keeping stakeholders updated via status pages
summary.what_it_does: FireHydrant provides on-call scheduling and alerting so teams know when something breaks and who is responsible. It offers automated runbooks to codify response steps, plus a service catalog showing service ownership and dependencies. Incidents can be managed within Slack or Teams, with AI-generated summaries, status page updates, and live transcriptions for Zoom and Google Meet. After an incident, it generates AI-enhanced retrospectives, captures and assigns action items, and offers analytics on MTTx and patterns. The page also lists an API with 350+ endpoints, Terraform support, and SDKs.
notable: AI-enhanced retrospectives and live meeting transcription for Zoom and Google Meet
Service catalog with ownership and dependency visibility
350+ API endpoints, Terraform support, and SDKs
Enterprise features: SOC 2, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, SCIM
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it only claims to be affordable
Page is mostly marketing claims (e.g. 90% faster resolution, 91% MTTM reduction from one customer quote) without detailed specifics
